_comment: spec: plr-d10-redesign-real-integration-2026-10-25 (lane REM-1, founder D-79 'unfinished work from daily logs'; R14). The id of the reminder a log task saved Partial, Delayed or Skipped leaves behind, the same on the server (ShramSafal.Domain.Planning.PlannedWorkIds.ForLeftover / ForLeftoverJobItem) and the phone (features/plannedWork/data/plannedWorkIds.ts leftoverTaskId / leftoverJobTaskId). RFC 4122 UUIDv5 in the same namespace as planned-work-ids.json. Name = '<log id, lower case>:leftover:<log task id, lower case>' (a task line, or the id of the line a content item stands for) or '<log id, lower case>:leftover:job:<index>' (an item of the voice parse a 1.0.17 phone confirmed). Values computed with RFC 4122 version 5 (checked first against the L8c-4 vector for 'plannedTasks:t1', computed with the 'uuid' package) and pinned on both sides by the C# and TS tests.
